items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 6 at 12:07PM PDT until October 8 at 2:00AM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description: * WHAT...For the first Small Craft Advisory, seas 3 to 6 ft at 10 seconds and north winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt. For the second Small Craft Advisory, seas 5 to 8 ft at 15 seconds and north winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt expected.  * WHERE...Inner Coastal Waters from Cape Shoalwater to Florence out 10 NM.  * WHEN...Small Craft Advisory, until 2 AM PDT Wednesday. Small Craft Advisory, from 1 PM Wednesday to 2 AM PDT Thursday.  * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
